Package com.csse3200.game.entities.factories

Class EnemyFactory

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.entities.factories.EnemyFactory
public class EnemyFactory extends Object
Creates enemy entities from configuration loaded from configs/enemies.json.

Unknown enemy ids fall back to a default enemy configuration.

    • create

      public static Entity create(String id, int floor)
      Creates an enemy by id with stats scaled for the given floor.

      Deeper floors produce tougher enemies through EnemyScaling. A floor of 0, or a negative floor, yields the enemy's base stats.

      Parameters:
      id - enemy id
      floor - the current run floor, used as the scaling progression
      Returns:
      the assembled enemy entity

    • getAtlasPaths

      public static String[] getAtlasPaths()
      Returns every texture atlas path the factory may render, so a game area can queue them for loading.

      Covers the shared default atlas and every roster enemy atlas. The result has no duplicates.

      Returns:
      the internal atlas paths used by enemies

    • loadAssets

      public static void loadAssets()
      Queues every enemy atlas and intent icon with the resource service. The caller is responsible for pumping the load (e.g. ResourceService.loadForMillis) and for calling unloadAssets() on teardown.

    • unloadAssets

      public static void unloadAssets()
      Releases every enemy atlas and intent icon previously queued by loadAssets().

    • getIdsByTier

      public static List<String> getIdsByTier(EnemyTier tier)
      Returns the ids of every roster enemy belonging to the given tier.

      Used by level design to pick enemies of a particular difficulty. Returns an empty list when nothing matches or the roster failed to load.

      Parameters:
      tier - the tier to filter by
      Returns:
      a new list of matching enemy ids
